purpose: Teach: 招聘/来賓/一報/区役所/登用/譲り/心掛け/御礼

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、有識者、絶対、招聘、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want you to bring in expert consultants. I'm serious about this. Move on it now.
lines.style: Steady, commanding opening. Direct eye contact. Each clause lands with clear weight. No pause for negotiation. Firm close on 頼んだぞ.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。式典、本気で、絶対、来賓、絶対、ご案内、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively coordinating the ceremony invitations for all key guests. Thank you for the clear direction.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Even pace, measured delivery. Shows competence without overcomplaining. Warm acknowledgement at the close, not obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約成立、本気で、絶対、一報、絶対、入れろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Once the contract is signed, get me word immediately. Don't wait.
lines.style: Sharp, clipped. Slight pause after 'signed' to let the urgency land. Lower register on the final clause. This is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、区役所、絶対、への、絶対、申請、絶対、完了しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The ward office paperwork went through as of today. I wanted to make sure you knew right away.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Paced to show completion. Slight lift on the final phrase—pride in execution. Not overeager, just factual confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手、本気で、絶対、登用、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Promote the younger staff. Build that pipeline now.
lines.style: Decisive, no filler. Short sentences. Lean forward slightly on 'promote.' This is strategy, not request. Weight lands on the action verb.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先代から、本気で、絶対、譲り、絶対、受けた、絶対、社風、絶対、大事にしております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We honor the company culture that's been passed down to us, and that's something I hold very seriously.
lines.style: Thoughtful and sincere. Slightly slower pace here—this matters to him personally. Solid ground beneath the words. Genuine respect in the delivery, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、絶対、心掛け、絶対、いつも、絶対、ほめろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Staff deserve recognition. Make sure you're acknowledging their work consistently.
lines.style: Softer register than before. Still commanding, but the undertone is human now. Slight warmth on 'acknowledgement.' This is values-driven, not a bark.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様への、本気で、絶対、御礼、絶対、状、絶対、お送りいたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I sent thank-you letters to our clients today. It felt important to reach out personally.
lines.style: Calm completion. Warm at the edges. The final phrase has gentle pride—small gesture, done with intention. Quiet confidence in follow-through.
